title: Isifungo Sesizalo
intro: Kwigumbi elithuleyo lentliziyo ezinikele kuThixo, kwaqatshelwa isifungo esingcwele. Esi sifungo sasigxile kubomi obungekaphefumlelwa, kwaye ukuzaliseka kwaso kwakuya kutshintsha indlela yelifa lokomoya ngonaphakade. Ngena kwimfihlakalo yomphefumlo onesithembiso esiphindaphindwa ngonaphakade.
clues: Ndandihlala kwikhaya elaziwa ngokuzinikela kwalo kuThixo, kwaye ndandilangazelela isipho esasiza kundisondeza ngakumbi ku-Allah.
Ndenze umnqophiso onzulu neNkosi yam malunga noko kwakufihliwe ngaphakathi kum, ndifunga ukuba ndiza kukunikela ngokupheleleyo enkonzweni Yakhe.
Xa kwafika ixesha lokutyhilwa, into endayifumanayo yayingalindelekanga, kodwa ndayiphathisa umninimzi yonke le nto.
Ndamnika umntwana wam igama elibonisa ukuzinikela, ndaza ndamcela ukuba akhuselwe yena nenzala yakhe kulowo uqalekisiweyo.
Umntwana wam wabekwa kwindawo engcwele, phantsi kolwalathiso lomprofeti ovela kwinzala ka-Aron.
Intombi yam yaziwa ngokuba msulwa kwayo yaza yonyulwa ngaphezu kwabo bonke abafazi, kamva yaba ngumama womprofeti omkhulu, nangona ingazange ichukunyiswe.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Isifungo sokunikela umntwana wakhe ongakazalwa etempileni
Uvavanyo lomonde ngenxa yokugula ixesha elide
Uhambo oluya kwilizwe elikude ngenxa yokholo
trial.answer: Isifungo sokunikela umntwana wakhe ongakazalwa etempileni

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Umntwana wakhe wamkelwa ngu-Allah waza wakhula phantsi kokhathalelo lwesiprofeto.
Umntwana wakhe waba ngumprofeti waza wafumana isibhalo esingcwele
Umntwana wakhe wanikwa ubulumko nobutyebi obukhulu
outcome.answer: Umntwana wakhe wamkelwa ngu-Allah waza wakhula phantsi kokhathalelo lwesiprofeto.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
